name: Sugisawa Yuna
source:
She is quick to get things done, but always manages to leave some things out. She is an optimist who thinks that things will always work out.

She loves coffee, tea, cola, and other caffeinated drinks. She works part-time at a coffee shop.

From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=7009]getchu[/url]]
